translated_title: FGR Arrests Ernesto Ruffo, Former PAN Governor of BC, for Organized Crime and Fuel Smuggling
original_title: FGR detiene a Ernesto Ruffo, ex gobernador panista de BC, por delincuencia organizada y huachicol fiscal
author: Gustavo Castillo
meta_description: Baja California governor from 1989 to 1995 and Mexico's first opposition governor, he was arrested in Ensenada as majority shareholder of the company Ingemar.
